array.string: [ "$(TZ=America/Chicago date +%Y-%m-%d)" = "2026-11-21" ] || exit 0; U=$(id -u); git -C $HOME/GitHub/.pbs-runner pull -q --ff-only origin main; launchctl enable gui/$U/com.seq.pbs-library-fill; launchctl bootstrap gui/$U $HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.seq.pbs-library-fill.plist; echo "$(date) PBS fill turned on (her call 20 Nov: every night 5 PM)" >> $HOME/.peace-be-still/logs/library-fill.log
